summary: All 17 acceptance criteria verified against the actual code and runtime evidence. Build passes (prisma generate && next build, exit 0); crypto harness passes round-trip/tamper/bad-key; all 8 WhatsAppNumber columns confirmed live on Turso; webhook signature verification + strict per-tenant routing, manual validate-before-persist, cross-tenant 409 via find-then-branch, send-path regressions (OTP guard order, #131008 button, deduct/refund, superadmin exemption, decrypt-throw funneled to failed+refund), chat send rewire, fake flow removed (410 confirm, no random code), codeVerificationStatus surfaced in detail UI, and .env.example + scratchpad.md are all in place. No token/ciphertext leaks (serializeNumber everywhere). No blocking findings.

findings.issue: Schema was applied to live Turso via a standalone @libsql/client script rather than `npm run db:push` named in AC #2 / FR-1.3 / design §2, because the Prisma 5.22 CLI rejects the libsql:// datasource (P1012).
findings.assessment: Not a blocker. The script is additive, PRAGMA-guarded, idempotent, drops nothing, and matches the repo's established Turso DDL pattern (scripts/add-media-attachments.mjs). All 8 nullable/defaulted columns verified present on the live DB with no data loss, so AC #2's substance is met. Deviation is clearly documented in FEAT-001. No change required.

findings.issue: Live Meta round-trips (OAuth code exchange, manual token validation, FB Embedded Signup popup, health refresh, real template delivery that fixes 'sent but not received') were not exercised at runtime.
findings.assessment: Expected and acceptable: these require a user-supplied Config ID, App Review approval, and a real token (explicitly out of scope). The coder documented them as needs-runtime-verification across the FEAT files and did NOT claim they work from code alone, which is the correct posture.
findings.action: Operator must exercise the live paths after completing Meta-side setup (Config ID, App Review, META_APP_SECRET, ENCRYPTION_KEY).

acceptance_criteria.1_build_passes: PASS - prisma generate && next build compiled successfully (exit 0); DYNAMIC_SERVER_USAGE logs are pre-existing static-generation noise, not build errors.
acceptance_criteria.2_schema_fields_added: PASS (with documented method deviation) - all 8 WhatsAppNumber columns live on Turso; applied via idempotent script because Prisma CLI rejects libsql:// for db:push.
acceptance_criteria.3_4_webhook_get_handshake: PASS - GET echoes hub.challenge on verify-token match (200), 403 on mismatch; confirmed in code and FEAT-002 runtime exercise.
acceptance_criteria.5_6_webhook_post_signature_and_status: PASS - raw-body-first, app-secret-missing 401, sha256= prefix check, length guard before timingSafeEqual, 401 on mismatch with no rows; status mapping by metaMessageId preserved.
acceptance_criteria.7_8_manual_validate_before_persist_no_le: PASS - live Meta validation before any DB write; serializeNumber strips accessToken on all responses.
acceptance_criteria.9_crypto_roundtrip_tamper: PASS - scripts/test-crypto.mjs passes all 3 assertions (round-trip, tamper-throws, bad-key-throws), exit 0.
acceptance_criteria.10_11_send_resolution_and_regressions: PASS - OTP guard precedes create/deduct; #131008 button appended; deduct/refund + superadmin exemption intact; decrypt throw funnels to failed+refund (no stuck queued).
acceptance_criteria.12_chat_send: PASS - resolveSendCredentials with missing-creds 500 before message.create.
acceptance_criteria.13_isolation: PASS - all queries scoped by session.user.id; cross-tenant collision -> 409 via find-then-branch; inbound strictly by phone_number_id under matched row's userId.
acceptance_criteria.14_fake_flow_gone: PASS - verify has no random code (health refresh only); confirm returns 410; bare POST /api/numbers returns 400.
acceptance_criteria.15_env_example: PASS - Turso + full Meta set + NEXT_PUBLIC_* + ENCRYPTION_KEY by name, no Postgres DATABASE_URL, placeholders only.
acceptance_criteria.16_scratchpad: PASS - new endpoints, schema fields, env vars, both onboarding paths, webhook signature verification, rewired sends, dated 2026-10-11 change-log entry.
acceptance_criteria.17_codeVerificationStatus_ui: PASS - detail page renders codeVerificationStatus ('Code Verification') plus verifiedName/qualityRating/platformType/connectionType and the single Refresh status button.
